title: DatasetWidget's option-color / dimension-label probe reads the global `fetch`, bypassing the host's `apiFetch` channel (the plugin-dashboard twin of #4114)
body:
Found while fixing #4114 in `plugin-charts`. Filing rather than fixing: #4114's scope is `ObjectChart` only, and this is a second component in a different package.

## The defect

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx:589` makes the same metadata read off the **global** `fetch`:

```
const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/meta/object/${encodeURIComponent(object)}`, { headers: { accept: 'application/json' }, credentials: 'include' });
```

Same document, same purpose as the probe #4114 fixes: it feeds `buildOptionColorMap` (per-category colors for the first dimension) and `buildDimensionLabelMap` (the per-dimension value → label maps for the axis/series). Same best-effort shape too — the effect swallows every failure and leaves both maps `null`, so a hosted console gets no error, just the positional theme palette and raw stored values where semantic colors and option labels were authored.

`SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch` is the repo's channel for host-authenticated API reads (`useRecordEditable.ts:32` documents it; `ObjectGantt.tsx:461-468`, `useViewData.ts:100-107` and now `ObjectChart.tsx` implement it; `ConsoleShell.tsx:245` is the host that supplies it). A bearer-token session carries its credential in the `Authorization` header rather than a cookie, so `credentials: 'include'` alone leaves this read unauthenticated.

## Why it is filed separately rather than folded into #4114

#4114's own body flagged the sibling ("whichever way this is resolved should probably cover both"), and PR #4115's attribution had already established that `plugin-dashboard` emits **zero** live requests under its suite — `DatasetWidget.relabel.test.tsx:70` answers this endpoint from a double. So the escape is invisible in tests here; only the hosted-console consequence is real, which is why it needs its own card rather than riding along on a chart fix.

## Suggested direction

The same one #4114 landed: read `SchemaRendererContext` (`DatasetWidget` would need to add the read — unlike `ObjectChart` it does not consult that context today, so check whether the widget is always rendered under a provider before deciding where the read goes) and use `apiFetch ?? fetch`, keeping the global fallback for standalone embeds. The routing is directly assertable with the two-recorder pattern added in `ObjectChart.optionColors.test.tsx` under #4114 (host recorder holds the call, global recorder holds nothing).

Filed unassigned for triage.
